# two_female_v1: descriptive baseline across two female individuals

Version: 1. Preregistered and SHA-256 frozen before BANC simulation.
Label: descriptive replication on a second individual.
No new confirmatory decision is made. Female brain graph alone, with no
arena or male. The existing female_no_v1 execution protocol is retained;
the graph and dictionary selectors are changed as specified below.

## Inputs and population scope

New execution: build/graph_banc.npz, BANC v888, sign rule shiu2024.
Comparison: build/graph_female.npz, FAFB v783, Shiu exported connectivity,
sign rule shiu2024-parquet. FAFB results are read exclusively from
records/female_no_v1_experiment.json, never regenerated for this comparison.
Freeze the SHA-256 of both NPZ files, both build/dictionary_*.json snapshots,
the baseline JSON, this text and execution sources before collecting data.

Use dictionary JO-A and JO-B selectors, excluding unclear annotations.
FAFB SAG remains the original protocol's union of exact AN_SMP_2,
AN_FLA_SMP_2 and ANXXX983 labels, not the dictionary's SpsP proxy.
BANC SAG uses the dictionary's exact ANXXX983 alias; no missing FAFB
candidate label is substituted. pC1 pools exact pC1a-e dictionary entries;
BANC pC1 additionally requires superclass=central_brain_intrinsic.
vpoDN is the dictionary selection intersected with exact DNp37.
Record all selected body IDs, graph indices, counts, types and superclasses.
DNp37 is present in the inspected BANC snapshot (two cells).
If a readout is absent, it must be labelled unavailable, never zero activity.

The supplied BANC NPZ is used intact. Its actual construction filter is
proofread OR roughly_proofread, excluding forbidden statuses and glia,
with induced connectivity. It is not an exclusively central-brain graph.
The requested central_brain_intrinsic note is absent from the local
records/dictionary_e3_report.md. Here this superclass is a pC1 selector
filter, not a global graph filter: JO-A/B are sensory, SAG ascending and
DNp37 descending, and a global filter would remove these required targets.
The full BANC network includes ventral nerve cord populations. These scope,
annotation and sign-source differences limit individual-level attribution.
4,344,932 BANC synapses are outside its construction population. Do not
compare raw synapse totals as if both datasets covered the same population.

## Unchanged execution protocol

Conditions: virgin_song, mated_song, virgin_silence, mated_silence.
Virgin: tonic 50 Hz Poisson SAG input in every window; mated: 0 Hz.
Song: a=1, m=0.7, a*(m*pulse+(1-m)*sine). Silence: zero waveform.
All zero-rate drive targets remain present to preserve paired random draws.
Target order: JO-A, JO-B, SAG, ascending graph indices within each group.
Seeds: 0 through 9, identical in every condition and kernel, each from rest.
Primary kernel: shiu. Secondary kernel: jump, descriptive only, if the
45-minute total task budget permits. Run quick before full; quick has seeds
0,1 and 6 windows. Incomplete execution is reported as partial.

Timing: 50 ms windows, 20 windows (1 second), first 4 windows warm-up,
last 16 windows measured. Group output is mean Hz per cell across measured
windows. dt=0.2 ms, 250 steps per window. Quick excludes its first 4 windows
and measures its last 2; quick is preliminary, not a substitute for full.

Song: sample rate 22050 Hz; pulse IPI 35 ms, width 4 ms, Hann window,
250 Hz carrier; sine song 150 Hz. Carry sample clock and carrier phase across
windows. Amplitude is bounded by 0..1.
Ear: fourth-order Butterworth bandpasses, JO-A 100-500 Hz, JO-B 500-2500 Hz;
sosfiltfilt padlen=27 on each 50 ms window. Every 5 ms slice gives
180*clip(band RMS/RMS_FULL,0,1) Hz. RMS_FULL is JO-A band RMS of a
full-amplitude 1 second pulse train, computed once at import and recorded.
Synthesis references retained from female_no_v1: von Philipsborn 2011,
Neuron 69:509; Clemens/Murthy 2018, Nature Communications; Zhou 2015,
eLife 4:e08477. These are synthesis choices, not brain measurements.

Use runner.run directly, CUDA fast_gpu float32 and unchanged Parameters.
No simulator, hook, ear, dictionary entry, calibration or gain changes.
No runner refactor is needed. Preserve the original FAFB protocol and records.

Predictions (registered before data):
All outputs below are descriptive replication on a second individual.
(a) For each kernel, condition and readout (vpoDN, pC1), report mean +/- SE
across seeds for saved FAFB results and new BANC results, in Hz per cell.
SE = sample SD / sqrt(number of seeds).
(b) BANC P1: vpoDN virgin_song minus mated_song; P2: vpoDN virgin_song minus
virgin_silence; P3: pC1 virgin_song minus mated_song. Report ten paired seed
differences and their mean +/- SE, with a descriptive label and no threshold.
(c) For both graphs and kernels, report total network Hz per neuron and
the fraction of measured seed-windows with network rate strictly >30 Hz
per neuron. Exclude warm-up; give every condition separately.
(d) For each condition and readout, compute seedwise FAFB minus BANC and
report abs(mean difference) / SE of those paired differences. Pair by seed
number, not by row position. No threshold or population-level inference.
Zero SE with zero mean is undefined (0/0); zero SE with nonzero mean is
unbounded. Store null plus the explicit reason, never a fabricated zero.
Seed pairing is a computational convention: different graph/target sizes
do not imply identical random streams or paired biological replication.
Also retain descriptive P4: mated_song minus mated_silence in both readouts
and kernels; jump minus shiu in every condition and readout.

CHOSEN: amplitude 1, pulse mixture 0.7, dt 0.2 ms, JO_MAX_HZ 180,
scale 1.0 using Shiu W_syn; no additional gain and no calibration.
Report all directions, silence and ignition. Compact records stay below
5 MB in records/; complete window and drive data stay in build/records-raw/.
The report embeds this preregistration verbatim and is rendered from saved JSON.
Song conditions are stress tests of the existing ear front end, not
measurements of female hearing. The engineering ceiling and band assignment
do not establish physiological transduction; the spike-only chemical model
does not represent the graded and electrical relay described in README.
these readouts do not establish hearing, refusal or mating
